_comment: Milestones and tasks created by tools/new-port.sh. Titles match skills/port-playbook/milestones.md. Each task depends on the previous task of its milestone; the first task of a milestone depends on the previous milestone's gate.

milestones.title: M0 Setup
milestones.description: Host tools, workspace, learner profile, safety briefing. Risk: green.

tasks.title: Check host tools
ac: tools/check-host.sh reports no blocking item for M0-M3

tasks.title: Create learner profile
ac: learner section of port.yaml filled (level, depth, language, experience)

tasks.title: Safety briefing
ac: Risk colors, gates, soft/hard brick explained
User confirmed personal data is backed up or not needed
Accepted irreversible costs recorded in learner.accepted_costs

tasks.title: Root preference
ac: What root is, what it unlocks for the port (full recon, raw partition backups) and what it costs on this vendor explained
Answer recorded in safety.root (already / wanted / declined)

tasks.title: GATE M0: ready to investigate the device
ac: All M0 tasks Done
Kickoff lesson given (three pillars, journey map)
User said go

milestones.title: M1 Reconnaissance
milestones.description: Read-only investigation of the device over adb. Risk: green.

tasks.title: Collect Android properties and hardware info
ac: dossier/raw/ populated by tools/recon/collect.sh
Unreadable items listed with the reason

tasks.title: Identify the SoC, board and peripheral chips
ac: SoC, arch, RAM, storage identified with sources
Display, touch, WiFi/BT, modem, PMIC/charger listed (or unknown with a plan)

tasks.title: Map the partition table
ac: dossier/partitions.md lists every partition with size and class A/B/C/D
Unknown partitions are class A

tasks.title: Identify the boot image format
ac: Header version, page size, offsets, DTB placement known or sourced from pmaports
device.bootimg in port.yaml filled

tasks.title: Check bootloader and secure-boot state
ac: Lock state, verified boot state, OEM unlock support, warranty/KNOX bits recorded
Flash mode identified

tasks.title: Root-enhanced recon
ac: Done with root reads if safety.root is already
Otherwise closed as Done with a note: deferred to Get a root shell (M5), or N/A when root is declined or not possible

tasks.title: Write device dossier summary
ac: dossier/device.md written with a source for every fact
device section of port.yaml filled

tasks.title: GATE M1: we know the device
ac: SoC, arch, partition map, flash mode, boot format known with sources
M1 lesson given
User said go

milestones.title: M2 Prior art
milestones.description: Find existing Linux work, choose the kernel and boot path. Risk: green.

tasks.title: Clone or update pmaports
ac: cache/pmaports up to date

tasks.title: Search pmaports for the device and SoC
ac: Device, kernel and firmware packages found or confirmed absent
Sibling devices on the same SoC listed

tasks.title: Search the postmarketOS wiki
ac: Device and SoC pages summarised with links

tasks.title: Search mainline Linux and SoC forks
ac: DTS for the board/SoC located or confirmed absent
SoC community forks listed with activity dates

tasks.title: Check second-stage bootloader support
ac: lk2nd/U-Boot support for SoC and device checked

tasks.title: Search downstream sources (LineageOS, vendor)
ac: Device/kernel trees and blob repos listed

tasks.title: Feasibility verdict and kernel path decision
ac: dossier/prior-art.md written
Reusable buildroot-android pieces listed (closest board, packages)
Decision recorded (kernel repo + ref + config + DTB, boot path)
path section of port.yaml filled

tasks.title: GATE M2: go or no-go
ac: Scenario and confidence explained to the user
M2 lesson given
User said go (or chose to stop)

milestones.title: M3 Unbrick kit
milestones.description: Prove we can always return to stock before changing anything. Risk: green/yellow.

tasks.title: Locate and download stock firmware
ac: Stock firmware matching the build fingerprint (or newer) in backups/stock with sha256
Source URL recorded

tasks.title: Install and test the flash tool
ac: Tool installed
A read-only command (getvar / print-pit / printgpt) works against the device

tasks.title: Test every boot mode entry
ac: Bootloader/download, recovery and force-power-off combos tested by the user
device.modes in port.yaml filled

tasks.title: Document the emergency recovery procedure
ac: dossier/unbrick.md covers soft brick, bootloop, stock reflash, EDL/BROM

tasks.title: Research the root method
ac: Skipped if safety.root is declined or already
Method for this device (custom recovery, patched boot image, vendor tool) with sources, what it writes and how to undo it
safety.root_method set, or safety.root set to not-possible

tasks.title: GATE M3: unbrick kit ready
ac: safety.unbrick_kit_ready true
M3 lesson given
User said go

milestones.title: M4 Unlock
milestones.description: Unlock the bootloader with informed consent. Risk: orange (wipes data).

tasks.title: Research the unlock procedure for this device
ac: dossier/unlock.md with procedure, irreversible effects, two sources

tasks.title: Pre-unlock checklist
ac: Plan file written by flash-guardian with all checks green
User accepted the costs explicitly

tasks.title: Unlock the bootloader
ac: Executed from the approved plan, log saved
Or marked not-needed with evidence

tasks.title: Verify unlocked state and Android still boots
ac: Unlocked state shown by the bootloader
Android boots, adb re-authorised
safety.bootloader_unlocked updated

tasks.title: GATE M4: bootloader open
ac: M4 lesson given
User said go

milestones.title: M5 Backup
milestones.description: Dump and verify every partition we could ever need. Risk: green/yellow; orange if the root shell needs a flash.

tasks.title: Get a root shell
ac: N/A if safety.root is declined, already or not-possible
RAM-only method (fastboot boot of a recovery or patched boot image) used when the bootloader allows it
If a write is needed: the target is class D, its stock image from backups/stock/ is copied to backups/<name>.img and added to SHA256SUMS, and the partition is allowlisted with the user's agreement
Flash plan approved by the user and run through flash-guardian
Root adb shell confirmed (id shows uid=0)
Root-enhanced recon re-run and the M1 gaps filled

tasks.title: Choose the backup method
ac: Method chosen (root dd / temporary recovery / vendor read tool) and recorded

tasks.title: Dump all partitions except userdata and system
ac: backups/<name>.img for every partition except userdata/system/super
Class B partitions dumped first

tasks.title: Verify backups and store a copy off the machine
ac: sha256sum -c backups/SHA256SUMS passes
User confirmed an off-machine copy

tasks.title: Set the writable partitions allowlist
ac: safety.writable_partitions set with the user's agreement (default boot + userdata)
Every listed partition has a verified backup, or its loss is recorded in safety.accepted_loss after the user confirmed (userdata)

tasks.title: GATE M5: safety net in place
ac: safety.backups_verified true
M5 lesson given
User said go

milestones.title: M6 Boot path
milestones.description: A repeatable way to load our own kernel without touching the bootloader chain. Risk: yellow/orange.

tasks.title: Decide whether a second-stage bootloader is needed
ac: dossier/boot-path.md written
M2 boot path decision confirmed or revised with what M3-M5 showed
experiment_partition set if there is no RAM boot

tasks.title: Round-trip test with the stock boot image
ac: Stock boot image booted from RAM, or flashed back to its own partition, and Android boots

tasks.title: Install or temporarily boot the second stage
ac: lk2nd/U-Boot running from RAM or from the experiment partition via an approved plan
Or marked N/A per the decision

tasks.title: Verify the second stage offers fastboot and boots extlinux
ac: fastboot devices shows it
aboot flash mode (fastboot / Samsung download mode) still reachable to reflash boot
path.boot_method recorded

tasks.title: GATE M6: we can load our own kernel
ac: M6 lesson given
User said go

milestones.title: M7 First light
milestones.description: Our kernel prints its boot log on the phone screen, from RAM. Risk: yellow.

tasks.title: Fork or clone buildroot-android
ac: ports/<id>/buildroot-android cloned from the user's fork, on branch port/<id>
repos.buildroot_android set in port.yaml

tasks.title: Prepare the kernel source and config
ac: Kernel repo/ref pinned
Config with the first-light options

tasks.title: Build the first-light defconfig
ac: <id>_firstlight_defconfig builds
boot.img produced, fits the partition

tasks.title: Boot it temporarily
ac: Booted with tools/await-boot.sh (or path.boot_method + --watch-only)
Result recorded in journal/boots/ (photo in journal/photos optional)

tasks.title: Analyse the result
ac: await-boot PASS, or a diagnosis with the next experiment

tasks.title: GATE M7: first light
ac: await-boot PASS record (KIT-READY over USB) or a photo of the kernel log and the init banner
M7 lesson given
User said go

milestones.title: M8 Rescue shell
milestones.description: A RAM-only Buildroot system with USB networking and ssh. Risk: yellow.

tasks.title: Build the rescue initramfs defconfig
ac: <id>_rescue_defconfig builds with dropbear, unudhcpd and the gadget script

tasks.title: Boot rescue and connect over USB networking
ac: ssh root@10.0.42.1 works
reboot-mode from the shell returns to the flash mode without keys

tasks.title: Linux hardware inventory
ac: Linux dmesg saved
Working/failing devices listed with the reasons
Battery voltage and charger state read from /sys/class/power_supply

tasks.title: Map Android partitions to Linux block devices
ac: dossier/partitions-linux.md maps mmcblk0pN to names and classes

tasks.title: GATE M8: shell into Linux
ac: M8 lesson given
User said go

milestones.title: M9 Persistent Buildroot
milestones.description: A real Buildroot system on flash, in buildroot-android style. Risk: orange.

tasks.title: Add the board to buildroot-android
ac: board/<id> (linux.config, overlay, genimage, post-image) and configs/<id>_defconfig on branch port/<id>

tasks.title: Choose rootfs placement and boot flow
ac: Decision recorded
path.rootfs_placement set

tasks.title: Build the full system
ac: <id>_defconfig builds; images fit their partitions

tasks.title: Flash plan and first persistent flash
ac: Approved plan executed
Only allowlisted partitions written
Read-back hash matches

tasks.title: Boot, ssh in, check reflash cycle
ac: Survives a reboot
reflash.sh works by serial
Rescue RAM boot still works

tasks.title: Choose what comes next with the user
ac: User chose: Nerves now, peripherals first, or a subset then Nerves
Decision recorded; path.after_buildroot and path.peripherals set
Peripheral tasks not chosen labelled deferred (kept)

tasks.title: GATE M9: Buildroot lives on the phone
ac: M9 lesson given
User said go

milestones.title: M10 Hardware
milestones.description: Peripherals the user cares about, one child task each. Risk: orange.

tasks.title: Make charging work and read the battery
ac: Battery voltage readable (PMIC ADC or fuel gauge), and capacity when a fuel gauge exists
Charges on a PC port and on a wall supply
Keeps charging across every reboot and flash path the port uses (warm/cold reset, vendor flash mode, second-stage bootloader)
Re-checked after each flash path was first used

tasks.title: Prioritise peripherals with the user
ac: Child tasks created per peripheral with ACs

tasks.title: Write the init-scripts inventory for Nerves
ac: dossier/init-inventory.md lists every script, daemon, blob and config

tasks.title: GATE M10: hardware enabled
ac: Chosen peripherals work or are documented as deferred
M10 lesson given
User said go

milestones.title: M11 Nerves
milestones.description: Nerves with A/B updates inside the Android partitions. Risk: orange.

tasks.title: Design the A/B layout inside Android partitions
ac: Decision with exact offsets/sizes
path.nerves_layout set

tasks.title: Bootstrap the Nerves system
ac: nerves_system_<id> builds

tasks.title: Review the system against official Nerves systems
ac: dossier/nerves-config-review.md: option | Buildroot port | official Nerves | chosen | why
First-light and debug options removed (CONFIG_LOGO, verbose loglevel)
erlinit.config, fwup.conf and the overlay compared with the official templates

tasks.title: Boot flow for slot switching
ac: Slot selection and revert designed and tested on file images

tasks.title: Port init scripts to Elixir
ac: Each init-inventory row has an Elixir replacement or a task

tasks.title: Build firmware and first flash
ac: Approved plan executed
IEx reachable over ssh

tasks.title: Test mix upload, revert and factory reset
ac: mix upload boots the other slot
Revert returns to the previous slot
Factory reset clears the application data partition

tasks.title: GATE M11: Nerves runs
ac: M11 lesson given
User said go

tasks.title: Write device documentation
ac: docs/<id>.md in buildroot-android: what works, how to flash, partitions

tasks.title: Prepare a PR to buildroot-android
ac: Branch ready; the user decided whether to open the PR

tasks.title: Write the Dependencies section of the Nerves system's README
ac: Host packages per distribution, udev rules for every USB mode, one-time phone setup, battery and cable rules

tasks.title: Write the one-command installer (stock phone to Nerves)
ac: Dry run by default, exact plan printed, typed confirmation naming irreversible costs
Preflight identity checks, unlock if needed, class B backups before any write
Bootloader and latest release written to allowlisted partitions only, every asset checksum-verified
Forbidden list built in; recovery hints at every failure point
Reviewed by flash-guardian

tasks.title: Set up the release recipe (images, SHA256SUMS, GPL sources)
ac: A release carries the raw image, bootloader image, SHA256SUMS and GPL source references

tasks.title: Compile the learner journal
ac: journal/README.md tells the story with links to all lessons

tasks.title: GATE M12: done
ac: Celebration 🎉
Next device ideas noted
